title: On Revolutionary Medicine
author: Che Guevara
context: Delivered on August 19, 1960, to the Cuban Militia, this speech traces Che's personal transition from an individual medical doctor traveling Latin America into a revolutionary combatant, laying the theoretical foundation for universal socialist healthcare and socialized medicine.
relatesToToday: Crucial for contemporary debates on universal healthcare, the commodification of medicine under capitalism, and redefining professional careers around public service rather than private profit.
keyTakeaways: To be a revolutionary doctor or professional, there must first be a social revolution that transforms structural conditions.
Socialist medicine must prioritize social prevention and robust public health over commercial, curative big-city hospital treatments.
Individualist careerism must be replaced by channeling individual talents toward the collective benefit of society.
